question: Does the previously frozen 14-vector family retain its query-35 first hit when the public target scalar changes across the eight held-out fields?
target_law: For each selected (p,q), take d=1+(int(SHA256(UTF-8('xedni-target-diversity-v1|'+str(p)+'|'+str(q))),16) mod (q-1)); construct Q=dG outside the search interval. There is no rejection or reseeding.
query_law: Complete lexicographic (t1,t2) in [0,q)^2; public R_i=Q-t_i G
admission: Both public points nonidentity and distinct
test_order: At each admitted query test the unchanged 14 coefficient vectors in the parent listed order; stop immediately at the first relation with nonzero coefficient sum
cost_boundary: Count every query reached, each actual vector test, and every target-dependent abstract group-add call including lazy query generation through first hit; fixture construction and independent scalar replay are separate
falsifiers: query-35 pattern persists across the varied targets
observed prefix disagrees with exact modular relation law
claim_boundary: Exact finite-field first-hit operation counts for a deterministic varied-target panel; no wall-time or asymptotic claim
